title: Maximal topological complexity of monotone symplectic 4-manifolds
summary: We continue the study of Farber's topological complexity for monotone symplectic manifolds initiated in \cite{Or25}. First, we show that a closed spherically monotone symplectic manifold whose fundamental group contains no subgroup isomorphic to $\ZZ\oplus\ZZ$ is automatically toroidally monotone, with the same monotonicity constant.
